description: This Java source file defines the 'MetricsStatsCounter' class, which implements the 'StatsCounter' interface for Caffeine caches, integrating with 'DittoMetrics' to collect cache statistics with enhanced metrics tracking. It provides detailed metrics for cache hits, misses, load times, evictions, and invalidations, with mechanisms to create cache-specific instances and record various cache events.

classes.name: MetricsStatsCounter
classes.description: Implementation of Caffeine's StatsCounter interface that records cache metrics using DittoMetrics, supporting multiple counters for hits, misses, load times, evictions, and invalidations, with the ability to snapshot current cache stats.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of MetricsStatsCounter for a specific cache, configured with suppliers for max size and estimated size.

methods.name: recordHits
methods.description: Records a number of cache hit events.

methods.name: recordMisses
methods.description: Records a number of cache miss events.

methods.name: recordLoadSuccess
methods.description: Records a successful cache load, including load duration.

methods.name: recordLoadFailure
methods.description: Records a failed cache load, including load duration.

methods.name: recordEviction
methods.description: Records a cache eviction event with specified weight.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of current cache statistics.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MetricsStatsCounter instance.

methods.name: recordInvalidation
methods.description: Records invalidation of a cache entry.

methods.name: recordInvalidationWithoutItem
methods.description: Records an invalidation that did not target an existing item.
